title: Kylie Cantrall Taking Her ‘Valley Girl Problems’ on First Headlining Tour
summary: The Descendants star is set to perform across North America to celebrate the release of her new EP.
contentText:
After introducing fans to the world of Valley Girl Problems , Kylie Cantrall is inviting them to experience it live.

The singer and actress announced Monday (Aug. 3) that she’ll set out on her first-ever headlining tour this fall, bringing the Valley Girl Problems Tour to 15 cities across North America. The trek begins Sept. 25 in Minneapolis before making stops in Chicago, New York, Atlanta, San Francisco and more, wrapping Oct. 22 with a hometown show in Los Angeles.

“I’ve been waiting to bring this project to life onstage and create an epic show where my fans can experience the entire world of Valley Girl Problems with me,” Cantrall said in a statement. “This music is so personal, and I can’t wait to sing these songs together every night.”

The tour follows the release of Cantrall’s latest EP, Valley Girl Problems , which earned 2.5 million on-demand official streams in the U.S. in its first week of release, according to Luminate. The nine-track project was produced by Tricky Stewart, whose credits include Rihanna and Tyla , with songwriting contributions from Tayla Parx, who has written for musicians like Ariana Grande and Khalid . Alongside the EP, Cantrall also released an official music video for “Closet” as well as a series of visualizers inspired by the project’s aesthetic.

Though the Valley Girl Problems Tour is her first headlining tour, Cantrall is no stranger to performing for live audiences. The multihyphenate starred as Red, the daughter of the Queen of Hearts, in Disney’s Descendants: The Rise of Red before joining the Descendants/Zombies: Worlds Collide Tour last year, which played more than 40 sold-out arena shows across North America. She also starred in last month’s Descendants: Wicked Wonderland , whose soundtrack debuted at No. 1 on the Kid Albums chart and No. 2 on the Soundtracks chart.

Tickets and additional tour information are available through Cantrall’s official website .
